 Grammy ® Nominees To Be Unveiled Monday, Nov. 16
 The nominees for the 2027 Grammys will be revealed during a special presentation on Monday, Nov. 16, 2026, and announced by a star-studded lineup of Grammy-winning and Grammy-nominated artists, including Carly Pearce, David Guetta, Herbie Hancock, Juanes, Kehlani, Olivia Dean, Pharrell Williams, YUNGBLUD, Ziggy Marley, and many more.
 It's happening now! Follow all the latest 2027 Grammy Nominations on our Live Blog .
 WHO: Grammys CEO Harvey Mason jr. and Chair of the Recording Academy ® Board of Trustees Dr. Chelsey Green will be joined by a star-studded lineup of Grammy ® -winning and -nominated artists, including Alan Menken , Amy Allen , Carly Pearce , David Guetta , FYÜTCH & Aura V , Herbie Hancock , Israel Houghton , Juanes , Kehlani , Linda Perry , Meghan Foley & Michelle Holme , Olivia Dean , Pharrell Williams , Renée Fleming , YUNGBLUD , and Ziggy Marley , to announce the 2027 Grammy nominees .
 Hilton, the Official Hotel Partner of the 2027 Grammys ® , is a proud sponsor of the Grammy Nominations special presentation.
 WHAT: Nominees across all Categories for the 2027 Grammys will be revealed during a special presentation on Grammy.com and the Grammys YouTube channel , with special live coverage on "Good Morning America." The complete list of nominees will be published on Grammy.com at 9 a.m. ET / 6 a.m. PT and will also be announced via press release.
 The 2027 Grammys ® will celebrate the artistic excellence that defined the year in music. As music's only peer-recognized accolade, the Academy's nearly 16,000 Voting Members — made up of active music creators representing various music genres and disciplines, including songwriters, composers, producers, engineers, and more — are eligible to vote for the Grammys, ultimately determining the nominees and winners on Music's Biggest Night ® .
 The 2027 Grammys will air live at  7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT  from Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles on ABC, Sunday, Feb. 7, 2027 , and stream on Disney+ and Hulu.
 WHEN: Monday, Nov. 16 
 7:45 a.m. ET / 4:45 a.m. PT*: 
 Nominations Special Presentation Begins
 9 a.m. ET / 6 a.m. PT*: 
 Grammy Nominations Wrap-Up Show 
 Press Release and Complete Nominations list posted on Grammy.com
 * All times are approximate and subject to change. 
 WHERE: Grammy.com / YouTube / "Good Morning America"
For the first time, the Grammy Nominations special presentation will be broadcast live at The Square in Times Square, presented by Hilton.
Follow @Grammys on Instagram , Facebook , TikTok , and LinkedIn , and use #Grammys to join the conversation as it unfolds on Nov. 16.

 ABOUT THE GRAMMYS  
 Music is a powerful force for good in the world. It heals. It unites. It moves us like nothing else. The people who create it deserve an organization dedicated to their well-being. That's us. We exist to serve music, and all the people who make it. The Grammy organization is powered by 30,000 members, working songwriters, performers, producers, engineers, and music professionals, and we serve music people by spearheading public policy efforts to protect their rights, opening pathways of opportunity for them while dismantling old barriers, providing direct assistance, recognizing musical excellence, and upholding a peer-based Awards process that endures as music's highest honor. Our service positively impacts music creators everywhere, and results in a growing, thriving and more fair music industry.  
The Grammy organization is made up of the Recording Academy ® , The Latin Recording Academy ® , MusiCares ® , the Grammy Museum ® , and the Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation ® . For more information about the Grammys, please visit  Grammy.com . For breaking news and exclusive content, join the Grammys' social communities on Instagram ,  YouTube , TikTok , Facebook , LinkedIn ,  Threads , and  X . For media assets, please visit our  Press Room .
